chunks.text: Hello everyone, welcome back to Trustified India's person only 100% blind testing certification program
Guys, in today's video we will see the results of blind lab test report of Only What's Needed whey protein concentrate
We were getting requests for this product for a long time, so to test it blind, we ordered its 2 pouches from Swiggy
Swiggy is a third party seller platform, so we ordered its 2 pouches from the same anonymous ID
You can see the uncut unboxing video, which we get in the product, from that only one same batch number sealed product is available in the laboratory for testing
So, Trustified always does 100% blind testing honestly and ethically
Before talking about the lab test report, let's quickly cover its ingredients
So, you must be seeing the list of ingredients on our screen
In this, whey protein concentrate is used for protein content
For this, we have used whey protein concentrate for protein content
For mixability, we have used sunflower lecithin
For flavor, we have used cocoa powder
And for sweetness, we have used plant based sweetness stevia
So, these 4 ingredients are in this product
Now, let's move forward and see if their claim matches our blind lab test report or not
In level 1, we will talk about accuracy
So, let's talk about protein here
Protein company claims 72.73% as is basis
Keep in mind that they claim protein as is basis
So, we also claim as is basis as the result of lab test report
According to our lab test report, protein as is basis is 71.42%
Their egg serving is of 33 grams
And their claim is that protein in their 33 grams egg serving is 24 grams
Which according to our lab test report is 23.57 grams
Carbohydrate claim per serving is 4.02 grams
Which according to our lab test report is 4.42 grams
Fats company claims 1.68 grams per serving
Which according to our lab test report is 1.12 grams per serving
Which according to our lab test report is 1.98 grams per serving
In level 2, we have tested amino acid profile
So, you can see the report of amino acid profile on the screen
No sign of amino spiking has been found in it
In level 3, we have tested melamine spiking
So, melamine is below LOQ
If we talk about heavy metals
So, heavy metals are all below LOQ
But, cadmium has been detected
Although, it is found within the safe limit
In level 5, we have tested aflatoxins
So, aflatoxins are all below LOQ
In level 6, we have tested pesticides
You can see, we have tested a huge list of pesticides
And only 4 things have been detected
As in elemental copper
And all those things are within the safe limit
So, because this product has passed all our blind level of testing
So, we will move ahead and quickly cover its serving size accuracy
Mixability, taste, price, positives and negatives
First of all, we will see serving size accuracy
So, one serving size of 33 grams is mentioned here
No heaping scoop is mentioned anywhere
So, we will measure according to level scoop
And according to level scoop
Whatever result is coming on our kitchen weighing scale
You must be able to see that
If we talk about mixability
We will turn on the timer of 15 seconds here
After shaking for 15 seconds
If there is no lump in it
Then we will give rating of 5 stars
And if some lumps are detected
Then we will deduct some stars
So, after shaking for 15 seconds
Because there is no lump in it
So, in mixability, it is 5 out of 5 stars
So, we will give rating of 5 out of 5 stars
Let's talk about taste
So, its taste is of chocolate smooth type
And sweetness is also very balanced
Although, stevia has a little after taste
Which is normal
So, I will not say any wow or fantastic in taste
But its taste is on decent side
So, I will give rating of 3.5 out of 5 stars in taste
Now, let's talk about packaging
So, its packaging is good
It holds very well
In fact, it is a structure like dual sealing mechanism
So, the quality of packaging is good
But, main problem is in information presentation
So much information is filled on the label
That the pack looks like a newspaper
Some things like testing chart are unnecessary
And it should be on the website only
Not on the label
Ingredients are only four
And clearly visible
Despite that, they have been repeated
Which is useless
Instead of this repetition
An important info could have come
That their protein claim is on acid basis
Not on dry basis
But this information is not on the label
But on the website only
Also, the text is so small and overloaded
That the difference between front and back is not clear
Because of all these factors
The main highlights of the product
Like 73% protein content
No gums
No thickeners
They are hidden
And they are not properly visible
But anyways, this is my personal opinion
Let's move ahead and talk about its pricing quickly
So, its 1 kg pouch comes with 30g of protein
Which comes with 30 servings
That costs you Rs. 2670
The cost of one serving is Rs. 89
In which the company claims 24 gm of protein
So, considering that it is a whey protein concentrate
Which offers 70-73% protein
So, its pricing is on the fair side
And as per the competition
Now, in the last part
We will talk about the positives and negatives of this product
So, if we talk about the positive number 1
It has passed all the blind levels
If we talk about the positive number 2
Its mixability is good
If we talk about the positive number 3
Then it is a naturally sweetened
Naturally flavored whey
If you want to go towards that option
See, just for your sake of information
Let me tell you a very important thing
The artificial sweetener and artificial flavor
Which is in the whey in a tiny amount
They are also absolutely safe
And it has been used in the industry for years
In fact, the artificial sweetener
Is being used before the arrival of whey protein
So, both the options are absolutely safe
Ultimately, it all comes down to your choice
Let's talk about its negatives
So, I would like to say one negative about it
And that is
It has a lot of flavor restrictions
If you are not a chocolate or coffee person
Then you will not get any other flavor
Like vanilla and all
So, there are a lot of flavor restrictions in this
In fact, there is no unflavored version of this
